Sarah Oteifa, Cairo, Egypt, born on 29/07/1990. Received her B.Sc. in
Architectural Engineering, from The British University in Egypt at Cairo,
Egypt, 2012. M.Sc. in progress in Architecture and Environmental
engineeringfrom the Arab Academy of science and technology, Cairo, Egypt.
She is currently a Demonstrator at The British University in Egypt,
Architectural Engineering Department.
Professor Lobna Sherif, Cairo, Egypt. Received her B.Sc. in Architecture
from Ain Shams University, Egypt in 1979; her Master of Architecture from
Washington University, USA in1981; and her Doctorate in Architecture from
University of Michigan, USA in 1988.
Sheis currently aProfessor of Architecture and Dean of Education Affairs
at the Arab Academy for Science and Technology and Maritime Transport,
Cairo Campus. She teaches and publishes in architecture design, history,
theories and criticism of architecture.
Yasser Moustafa, Cairo, Egypt. Received his B.Sc. in Architecture from
Cairo University, Egypt in 1986; his Master of Architecture from the Illinois
Institute of Technology, USA in 1993; and his Ph.D. in Architecture from the
University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, USA in2004.
He is currently an Assistant Professor at the Department of Architecture,
College of Engineering, Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and
Maritime Transport, Cairo, Egypt. His research interests focus particularly on
environment-behavior relationships.
